text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E and A after large gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider each holding’s role and my overall plan.","I added to every stock in Period 6 without a clear outlook advantage. Since past price moves do not predict future ones, I should avoid treating recent prices as signals and make deliberate, diversified choices.","Doing nothing through the later declines avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still review the portfolio periodically against my goals rather than letting loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake dictate whether I hold."]}
